Candidate 1 (C385): UNIFORM BOGOMOLOV-PARSHIN ON MODULI OF CURVES OVER MIXED CHARACTERISTIC BASES
Claim 1: Uniform arithmetic Bogomolov inequality for stable curves over mixed characteristic bases provides explicit unconditional height bounds on Beal solutions.
Method 1: Arithmetic surface geometry, relative dualizing sheaves, Bogomolov-Parshin-Moriwaki inequalities, and Faltings heights.

Candidate 2 (C387): ABSOLUTE PRISMATIC COHOMOLOGY AND F-CRYSTALS OVER Z_p
Claim 2: Absolute prismatic cohomology R\Gamma_{\Prism}(X) on the Breuil-Kisin-Fargues prism forces non-trivial Frobenius Frobenius-eigenvalue bounds on Beal solutions.
Method 2: Prismatic cohomology, Breuil-Kisin-Fargues modules, and p-adic Hodge theory.

compatible.instructions: Are these two candidates mathematically compatible, operating on complementary aspects of the conjecture?

criteria.true: Yes, one provides input to the other or they address complementary signatures/invariants.
criteria.false: No, they operate in disjoint or contradictory frameworks.

combination_value.instructions: What value would combining these two candidate approaches create?

level 1: Minor bookkeeping convenience without resolving open obstacles.
level 2: Discharges a specific open obligation in one of the candidates.
level 3: Opens a genuine new attack route avoiding known dead ends.
